What awaits

A world with weight

Every ledge you can see, you can stand on. Nothing in the vale is painted scenery.

The Endless Vale

Walk from the brink to the central spire without a single loading screen. Districts stack in terraces; bridges hang over drops that will kill you.

Skyborne Traversal

Climb, glide and grapple between the floating isles. Wind has direction and thermals have height — read them or fall.

Bonds That Hold

Fourteen companions with their own routines, grudges and endings. Leave one behind at the wrong hour and they will not forget it.

One Save, Anywhere

Cloud saves sync mid-battle across PC, console and mobile. Put the handheld down, pick the fight back up on the big screen.
